rules.title: Contract incentive
rules.action: Offer a discounted one- or two-year contract, for example a price lock.
rules.rationale: In the final model, month-to-month contracts raise predicted risk and two-year contracts lower it.

rules.title: New-customer onboarding
rules.action: Schedule an onboarding check-in: service setup, first-bill walkthrough, satisfaction call.
rules.rationale: Short tenure is the final model's largest single risk driver.

rules.title: Security or support trial
rules.action: Offer a free trial of Online Security or Tech Support.
rules.rationale: Internet customers with neither security nor support carry higher predicted risk.

rules.title: Fiber service review
rules.action: Run a proactive service-quality check and review whether the price fits the plan.
rules.rationale: Fiber raises predicted risk. The data cannot say whether price or quality drives this, so investigate before offering discounts.

rules.title: Protect a high-value customer
rules.action: Offer a loyalty benefit or priority service; involve a senior retention agent.
rules.rationale: High monthly revenue is at risk, so a successful save is worth more.

rules.title: Review a recent bill increase
rules.action: Review the plan: the current bill is above the customer's own historical average.
rules.rationale: A bill rising above a customer's usual spend can prompt comparison shopping.

rules.title: Move to automatic payment
rules.action: Encourage automatic payment (bank transfer or card), for example with a small credit.
rules.rationale: Low-cost friction reduction. Payment method adds little to the final model's predictions, so this is not a model finding.

rules.title: Assisted support
rules.action: Offer an assisted support channel, such as a dedicated phone line or in-home setup.
rules.rationale: A service-quality suggestion, not a model finding.

disclaimer: Recommendations are rule-based suggestions, separate from the model's prediction. Their effect on churn has not been measured; test them, for example with a controlled A/B test, before rolling them out.
